items.title: Higher direct images commute with filtered colimits over a covering family of objects
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the higher direct images of a filtered colimit of abelian sheaves along a morphism of sites are the colimits of the higher direct images, provided the commutation is known on a family of objects covering every object of the target site (statement lines 2821-2832). The proof reduces the sheaf-theoretic statement to a pointwise one over the objects in B (proof lines 2834-2845) and then applies the hypothesis there (proof lines 2845-2852). The non-formal content is the reduction of a statement about sheaves to a statement about their values on a covering family. The claim is H2: one reduction plus one application of the hypothesis.
